title: Intelligenzbolzen
summary: A team project connecting exercise-sensing devices with an app to make physical activity more engaging.
content:
Our school robotics team developed Intelligenzbolzen around the idea of encouraging people to exercise. The project grew from the 2020/21 FIRST LEGO League theme and was also entered in Jugend forscht in 2021.

Measuring movement

We built sensor-equipped devices that connect to a phone over Wi-Fi. The app was designed to recognize and record exercises, show times and records in charts, and offer a two-player game.

The project combined electronics, sensor measurements and app development. It was shared team work; individual responsibilities still need to be described more precisely before publication.
